column1: # Frozen protocol for the HELD-OUT C4 synthetic-mosaic validation, committed before anything under it
# is simulated, called or evaluated. Nothing in this file may be edited after the first read is drawn:
# a setting or a metric changed once results exist is no longer a prediction, and the run stops being
# The development experiment (tests/genotype_c4_mosaic_experiment.sh) stands unchanged and is not
# re-run. This is the separate, untouched-data counterpart to it.
# The donor draw is a RULE, not a choice. scripts/draw_heldout_mosaic_plans.py derives every plan row
# the manifest gate re-derives them and refuses on any difference. See that script for the rule in full.
#   pool                   held_out role, exactly two C4 panel rows, BOTH rows forward-oriented, and
#                          not the C4 reference sample HG00096 -- 22 donors of the 56 held out
#   pairing                consecutive disjoint pairs of that order; ten pairs used
#   unused remainder       HG02554, HG00732 -- named here so the pool size does not silently decide the
# Why the pool is 22 and not 56: mosaic-truth refuses to splice a reverse-oriented walk against a
# forward one, so a donor with a reverse row cannot source a mosaic at all. C4 is 71 forward to 60
# reverse templates. This is a known limitation of the truth builder, recorded in
# docs/algorithms/genotype_mosaic_current.md, and it bounds the draw rather than being worked around.
# Excluded by construction, and checked by the gate rather than assumed:
#   - the development donor pair HG02666 x NA19240, and all eight development donors, whose role is not
#     held_out and which are therefore outside the pool;
#   - the five development switch plans {5}, {3,5}, {8}, {3,6,9} and "every": the draw rejects any set
#     equal to one of the first four, and the dense class draws eight points rather than alternating at
#     every block, so it cannot reproduce the fifth.
# CLASSES. Five, frozen, two donor pairs each. A class is a claim about what the caller must handle,
#   one_homologue_once   one homologue switched once, beside an INTACT panel haplotype. The diplotype is
#                        still off-panel, because a panel diplotype is a pair of panel rows and one of
#                        these is not. The development plans could not express this: they switched both
#   both_homologues      both homologues switched, each at its own point, so the two are not in lockstep.
#   three_switches       three switch points, on both homologues.
#   dense_switching      eight switch points of ten, on both homologues -- dense, and deliberately not
#   panel_control        unchanged panel haplotypes. NOT a mosaic: the truth IS a panel diplotype and is
#                        reachable without recombining. It is the control that says what the caller does
#                        when no mosaic is needed, and it is declared as such rather than exempted.
# REQUIRED OF EVERY MOSAIC (gated in the verify stage, before any read is simulated):
#   - the truth diplotype is absent from the curated panel: for require_off_panel=both neither homologue
#     is a panel row, for =one at least one is not. The controls declare =none and are then REQUIRED to
#     really be two panel rows, so a mis-drawn control fails rather than passing quietly.
#   - every constituent block allele remains representable: each block allele of both truth haplotypes
#     is carried by at least one template of the curated panel. A truth whose alleles the panel cannot
#     spell would measure representability, not genotyping.
# Simulation. A NEW seed, so the held-out reads are not drawn from the development stream; salted per
# plan, so no two plans share a random stream. The library is the frozen one, unchanged from the
# development experiment, so a difference in results cannot be a difference in read model.
# Coverage. Reads are simulated ONCE per plan at source_coverage; every lower coverage is a NESTED
# subset of that one simulation (genotype_probe subsample keeps a paired fragment when a hash of its
# name falls below the ratio), so coverage is not confounded with a fresh draw.
# Caller settings, frozen and NOT re-derived here: these are the production defaults selected by the
# declared width-ladder and K-ladder rule on development data. This protocol consumes them; it does not
# re-select them, and a held-out result may not be used to change them retroactively.
# METRICS, frozen before any result exists. Each names the file and key it is read from, so the report
# cannot quietly acquire a more flattering denominator later. Columns: metric, source file suffix, key.
